touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Refail qualifies as a local detour through Glansevern Hall Gardens and The Naissance Experience. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.

townGuide.headline: Refail: local heritage, daytime stops and an easy settlement wander
townGuide.intro: Refail offers Glansevern Hall Gardens, The Naissance Experience, Church of Saint Beuno (aka St Beuno) within a compact settlement visit, supported by curated daytime food and practical facilities where mapped.

suggestedFirstVisit.title: Glansevern Hall Gardens
suggestedFirstVisit.summary: Start with Glansevern Hall Gardens and The Naissance Experience, then use the planner for an in-boundary daytime stop.
